mechanics.stat_points: Exactly 66 total SP per Pokemon, max 32 SP per single stat. EV = 0 if SP == 0 else 4 + 8 * (SP - 1). Floor after +10%/-10% Stat Alignment.
mechanics.mega_evolution: Occurs during Activation Phase before Fake Out/Protect; speed tiers recalibrate immediately.
mechanics.redirection: Follow Me and Rage Powder cannot absorb spread moves. Airborne Pokemon do not receive Psychic Terrain priority immunity.
